text:
incident-bot: Incident #4827 (reed-router high tail latency) — pages fired 2024-11-08 02:14 UTC, mitigated by routing fallback at 02:41 UTC. Impact: elevated 95th latency for customer-facing inference requests (~8% of traffic). Triggering post-incident review. Who can facilitate and who needs to be looped in? Suggested slots next week. @maria @jordan @ashley

maria: I can take facilitator duties if no one else prefers it. Can do Tue/Wed mornings PT. Will need a scribe volunteer though. :raising_hand:

jordan: Could help with timeline prep and triage notes. Tue 10am PT (17:00 UTC) works for me. That gets EMEA folks late-afternoon.

ashley: I should be there for customer impact summary + billing exposure. Tue 10am PT might be tight for PM sync but I can move. Also +1 on having the pre-read timeline and alert graphs attached beforehand.

lee: Ops & infra should be included — I'll bring the instance + scaling metrics. Can anyone pull logs for the 02:10-02:50 window? I don't have raw log download access for that cluster.

oncall-bot: Reminder: the oncall transcript and page attachments were saved to /incidents/4827/recordings and the pager duty runbook snapshot is at https://internal.storage/incidents/4827/pager-snapshot.json

maria: ok copying a quick invite template below — if we lock Tue 17:00 UTC I'll send calendar and doc. Can someone scribe?

```
Title: Incident #4827 — Post-incident review
When: Tue 17:00 UTC (60m)
Agenda:
 - Timeline review (owner: jordan)
 - Customer impact & billing (owner: ashley)
 - Root cause & mitigation recap (owner: lee)
 - Action items, owners, deadlines (facilitator: maria)
 - Runbook & monitoring follow-ups
Pre-reads: timeline export, alerts, logs link, perf graphs
Docs: https://docs.internal/infra/4827-pir
```

jordan: scribe volunteers? I can scribe if maria prefers to run. I'm happy to split facilitation/scribe if needed.

ashley: I can scribe first 20m (impact + billing) and then hand off. Also, please add the customer-facing emails to the pre-read (redacted).

lee: I can handle logs if you grant me the export link — @infra-admin can you share the logs bundle to the docs link?

infra-admin (via thread): shared logs bundle to the doc — public link: https://internal.storage/incidents/4827/logs-bundle.tar.gz — added a short README with extraction steps.

maria: sweet. sounds like facilitator claimed. Quick attendee list proposal: infra, oncall, product PM, SRE lead, billing rep, support triage lead. Anyone else?

ashley: include eng-runtime oncall (they handled fallback), and the customer success rep for the affected account.

jordan: adding QA owner for regression checks.

maria: polling for final times: Tue 17:00 UTC or Wed 09:00 UTC. Please react with :one: for Tue, :two: for Wed.

ashley: :one:

jordan: :one: 

lee: :two: (prefer Wed but can make Tue if needed)

oncall-bot: Heads-up: if facilitator is set, bot will auto-create PIR doc skeleton and action-item tracker (use `/pir create 4827 --facilitator maria`).

maria: I'll run `/pir create 4827 --facilitator maria` after this thread. Can someone add the support case IDs to the doc? Support-case: #S-12987, #S-12988.

ashley: added cases to the doc. Also creating a JIRA action-board card: https://jira.internal/browse/INF-4827

jordan: thanks. For scribing: i'll draft the timeline + initial notes in the doc tonight, ashley you'll append impact section, lee add logs pointers.

maria: agreed — I'll send calendar invite for Tue 17:00 UTC and mark me as facilitator. If anything changes I'll update here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Scheduled reminder: postmortem pre-read due 24h before meeting. I'll ping channel then.

ashley: noted. tagging @customer-success to prep the impact blurb.

maria: claiming facilitator formally — moving to calendar + doc now. Closing thread for scheduling; please reopen if there's a conflict.
